visualCharacteristics.purpose: linked topic cards with image or looping video media
visualCharacteristics.description: Very light lavender band; centered intro text above a 3x2 grid of white cards | Cards: media top (image or looping video), H3, description, 'Learn more >' link | White cards with full-width image or looping video on top, H3, description and 'Learn more' arrow link; 3-up grid

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 holds an image or a link to an .mp4 video; cell 2 holds an H3, a description and a Learn more link
contentPattern.rationale: Repeating look-alike items linking to detail pages that wrap in a grid: Cards

usage: Grid of cards each with image or looping video, H3, description and a Learn more link.
reuseGuidance: Use for 3-up linked topic cards. Media cell accepts a picture or a link to an .mp4.
